title: Adversarial VQA: A New Benchmark for Evaluating the Robustness of VQA Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of Visual Question Answering (VQA) models. It does not contain any components that evaluate or benchmark aspects of religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The use of the word 'faithfully' in the introduction refers to answering accurately based on evidence in the image, not religious faith.
